comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and locks an end-effector stop; this record removes, wipes, reinserts, rereads, and reports an engine-oil dipstick level.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses coupled rotary tools and countertorque; the record performs long thin-part extraction/insertion, wiping, visual level reading, and report-token placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks mechanical retention through cycles; the record checks a valid clean reread, correct level report, reseated dipstick, and released rag/objects.
comparison.reason: Oil measurement and reporting exercise contamination-aware extraction and perception, not mechanical adjustment or locking.
